svg.title: One vote account. Three hosts.
svg.desc: Solana Validator Failover v0.7.0 with an optional third server. The primary is the usual holder and self-fences on local signals. The standby is the first spare with a 60-second default delay. The optional backup is the later spare with a 120-second default preset. The three hosts each use their own local RPC and monitor the same vote account. By default, either spare alerts the operator after its checks clear. Cold takeover is an explicit opt-in on each spare. In the installer, choose Standby, then Backup, and enter the first spare’s actual delay.
